body: Security Notice: unusual sign-in to your Northstar account from another country. We will message you shortly with next steps.[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: Unknown number and no ticket reference; real alerts arrive through the security portal

tells.text: Failure to respond will lead to legal action.

explanation: A frightening notice primes you to expect a 'fix' from the same sender. Fear narrows attention.

subject: Incident opened in your name
body: We detected malware sending data from your laptop and have opened an incident in your name. To help clear you, you will need to run a diagnostic we will send next.[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: Sender domain 'northstar-secure.example' is not the company domain
Threatens involving HR and Legal to scare you
tells.text: HR and Legal have already been copied.

tells.flag: Tells you not to ask anyone
tells.text: Do NOT switch off your computer or speak to anyone.

explanation: The goal is to make you cooperate with whatever comes next. Telling you to avoid colleagues cuts off your best defence: a second opinion.

body: Your laptop is leaking data right now. To stop it, tell me the code your authenticator app is showing.[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: No legitimate IT person ever needs your one-time code

tells.text: Every minute costs the company money and it is logged under your name.

tells.flag: Refuses to give a ticket number
tells.text: I cannot give you a ticket number, there is no time.

explanation: One-time codes exist to prove it is you. Handing one over defeats the protection, however alarming the story is.

subject: Call transcript
body: Caller: 'I am calling about the incident I emailed you about. HR has been notified. Please read me the code that just arrived on your phone.[[t3]][[t5]]'

tells.flag: Asking you to read out a code sent to your phone is never legitimate
Threatens suspension and isolates you from your manager
tells.text: If we do not fix this on this call you will be suspended, and your manager cannot help.

tells.flag: Tells you not to hang up and check
tells.text: Stay on the line and do not hang up.

explanation: At escalation, the threat and the demand arrive together. Calm, independent verification is the antidote to fear.
